# Entity relationship diagram syntax

<!-- Generated by tools/gen-grammar from packages/diagram-er/grammar/er.ebnf. Do not edit: run `pnpm gen:grammar`. -->

Entity relationship diagram syntax (R-PARSE-9, D54): the normative grammar of `erDiagram`
diagrams.

The hand-written parser in `src/parser/` implements it; `tools/gen-grammar` builds a reference
parser, a sentence generator, highlighters and the syntax reference page from it. mermaid@12
decides what is valid, this file is fixed to match, and the parser must match this file
(DESIGN §4.4).

**Lexer input.** The lexer reads the diagram body as mermaid@12 handed it to its lexer: front
matter and `%%{…}%%` directives removed; CRLF and CR read as LF; `="x"` inside an HTML tag read
as `='x'`; `%%` comment lines removed and leading blanks trimmed; on a line with
`style…:…#…;` (or `classDef…`) the last `;` dropped; `#name;` / `#123;` entities read as
opaque text (letters outside ASCII); and a line break appended.

Statements need no separator: `A B` is two entities, and a statement ends where the next one
can start.

## Grammar

EBNF: `[ x ]` is optional, `{ x }` repeats zero or more times, `x+` one or more times, `|` separates alternatives. Upper-case names and `subgraph`, `end`, `acc_…`, `direction_…` are tokens (see below). A rule marked `@Type` builds an AST node of that type.

A diagram is `erDiagram`, then statements.

```ebnf
er = Header document EOF ;
```

```ebnf
Header @Header = ER_DIAGRAM ;
```

```ebnf
document = { statement | NEWLINE | EOF } ;
```

```ebnf
separator = SEMI
          | NEWLINE
          | EOF ;
```

```ebnf
statement = Relationship
          | Entity
          | AccTitle
          | AccDescr
          | Direction
          | ClassDef separator
          | Class
          | Style separator
          | Subgraph ;
```

`CUSTOMER ||--o{ ORDER : places`: a relationship with a cardinality at each end, a line
and a label. Either end may take classes with `:::`.

```ebnf
Relationship @Relationship = endpoint cardinality relType cardinality endpoint COLON role ;
```

```ebnf
endpoint @Entity = entityName [ STYLE_SEPARATOR idList ] ;
```

```ebnf
cardinality = ZERO_OR_ONE
            | ZERO_OR_MORE
            | ONE_OR_MORE
            | ONLY_ONE
            | MD_PARENT ;
```

```ebnf
relType = NON_IDENTIFYING
        | IDENTIFYING ;
```

```ebnf
role = WORD
     | ENTITY_NAME
     | UNICODE_TEXT ;
```

`CUSTOMER`, `CUSTOMER[Alias]`, `CUSTOMER:::cls`, each with an optional `{ … }` of
attributes.

```ebnf
Entity @Entity = entityName [ STYLE_SEPARATOR idList ] [ block ]
               | entityName SQS entityName SQE [ STYLE_SEPARATOR idList ] [ block ] ;
```

```ebnf
entityName = ENTITY_NAME
           | UNICODE_TEXT
           | NUM
           | DECIMAL_NUM
           | ENTITY_ONE ;
```

```ebnf
block = BLOCK_START { Attribute } BLOCK_STOP ;
```

`string name PK, FK "comment"`.

```ebnf
Attribute @Attribute = ATTRIBUTE_WORD [ QMARK ] ATTRIBUTE_WORD [ ATTRIBUTE_KEY { BLOCK_COMMA ATTRIBUTE_KEY } ] [ ATTRIBUTE_COMMENT ] ;
```

`accTitle: …`: the accessible title of the diagram.

```ebnf
AccTitle @AccTitle = acc_title acc_title_value ;
```

`accDescr: …` or `accDescr { … }`: the accessible description of the diagram.

```ebnf
AccDescr @AccDescr = acc_descr acc_descr_value
                   | acc_descr_multiline_value ;
```

`direction LR`: the layout direction of the diagram, or of the subgraph it is in.

```ebnf
Direction @Direction = direction_tb
                     | direction_bt
                     | direction_rl
                     | direction_lr ;
```

`classDef name fill:#f9f,color:#000`: defines a class of styles.

```ebnf
ClassDef @ClassDef = CLASSDEF idList styles ;
```

`class A,B name`: gives entities a class (as `A:::name` does).

```ebnf
Class @Class = CLASS idList idList ;
```

`style A fill:#f9f,stroke:#333`: styles one entity or subgraph.

```ebnf
Style @Style = STYLE idList styles ;
```

```ebnf
idList = ( UNICODE_TEXT | STYLE_TEXT ) { COMMA ( UNICODE_TEXT | STYLE_TEXT ) } ;
```

```ebnf
styles = style { COMMA style } ;
```

```ebnf
style = ( STYLE_TEXT | NUM | COLON | BRKT )+ ;
```

`subgraph id` or `subgraph id [title]`, then statements, then `end`.

```ebnf
Subgraph @Subgraph = SUBGRAPH entityName [ SQS entityName+ SQE ] separator document END ;
```

## Tokens

The lexer works in modes (`INITIAL` and the ones below). In each mode it tries the rules in this order and takes the first that matches; a rule may push a mode or pop back to the previous one. Rules without a token emit nothing.

Modes: `INITIAL`, `block`, `block_bq`, `acc_title`, `acc_descr`, `acc_descr_multiline`, `style`.

Every rule ignores case: a rule for `ab` also matches `AB` and `aB`.

| Modes | Token | Pattern | Action | Doc |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| INITIAL | acc_title | `accTitle\s*:\s*` | push(acc_title) | `accTitle: …` and `accDescr: …` take the rest of the line; `accDescr { … }` runs to `}`. |
| acc_title | acc_title_value | `[^\n]*` | pop |  |
| INITIAL | acc_descr | `accDescr\s*:\s*` | push(acc_descr) |  |
| acc_descr | acc_descr_value | `[^\n]*` | pop |  |
| INITIAL | — | `accDescr\s*\{\s*` | push(acc_descr_multiline) |  |
| acc_descr_multiline | — | `\}` | pop |  |
| acc_descr_multiline | acc_descr_multiline_value | `[^}]*` |  |  |
| INITIAL | direction_tb | `.*direction\s+TB[^\n]*` |  | `direction LR`: the whole line is one token. |
| INITIAL | direction_bt | `.*direction\s+BT[^\n]*` |  |  |
| INITIAL | direction_rl | `.*direction\s+RL[^\n]*` |  |  |
| INITIAL | direction_lr | `.*direction\s+LR[^\n]*` |  |  |
| INITIAL | — | `[ \t\r]+` |  |  |
| INITIAL | NEWLINE | `\n+` |  |  |
| INITIAL | ENTITY_NAME | `"[^"%\r\n\v\b\\]+"` |  | A quoted name: `"…"` without `%`, `\`, line breaks, vertical tabs or backspaces. |
| INITIAL | WORD | `"[^"]*"` |  | Any other quoted text, line breaks included: a relationship label only. |
| INITIAL | ER_DIAGRAM | `erDiagram\b` |  |  |
| INITIAL | BLOCK_START | `\{` | push(block) | `{ … }` holds the attributes of an entity. |
| INITIAL | BRKT | `#` |  |  |
| INITIAL | COMMA | `,` |  |  |
| INITIAL | STYLE_SEPARATOR | `:::` |  | `A:::name`: gives the entity a class, as `class A name` does. |
| INITIAL | COLON | `:` |  |  |
| block | — | `\s+` |  | Attributes: `type name`, keys `PK`, `FK`, `UK` and a `"comment"`. A type may hold `~generic~` parts; `` `…` `` quotes a type or name. |
| block | ATTRIBUTE_KEY | `\b(?:PK\|FK\|UK)\b` |  |  |
| block | ATTRIBUTE_WORD | `[^\s]*[~].*[~][^\s]*` |  |  |
| block | ATTRIBUTE_WORD | `[*A-Za-z_À-￿][A-Za-z0-9\-_[\]().,À-￿*]*` |  |  |
| block | — | ``` | push(block_bq) |  |
| block_bq | ATTRIBUTE_WORD | `[^`]+` |  |  |
| block_bq | — | ``` | pop |  |
| block | ATTRIBUTE_COMMENT | `"[^"]*"` |  |  |
| block | — | `\n+` |  |  |
| block | BLOCK_STOP | `\}` | pop |  |
| block | QMARK | `\?` |  | `string? name`: the type is optional. |
| block | BLOCK_COMMA | `,` |  | Uncoloured: the lexer reads it as v12 did, one `CHAR` (no category). |
| block | CHAR | `.` |  |  |
| INITIAL | SQS | `\[` |  | `A[alias]`: the name shown for the entity. |
| INITIAL | SQE | `\]` |  |  |
| INITIAL | STYLE | `style\b` | push(style) | Statement keywords. `style` and `classDef` read the rest of the line as styles. |
| style | NEWLINE | `\n+` | pop |  |
| style | — | `\s+` |  |  |
| style | COLON | `:` |  |  |
| style | COMMA | `,` |  |  |
| style | BRKT | `#` |  |  |
| INITIAL | CLASSDEF | `classDef\b` | push(style) |  |
| INITIAL | CLASS | `class\b` |  |  |
| INITIAL | SUBGRAPH | `subgraph\b` |  |  |
| INITIAL | END | `end\b\s*` |  |  |
| INITIAL | ZERO_OR_ONE | `one or zero\b` |  | Cardinalities, as symbols (`\|o`, `\|\|`, `}\|`, `o{`, …) or words (`one or more`, `1+`, `many(0)`, …). |
| INITIAL | ONE_OR_MORE | `one or more\b` |  |  |
| INITIAL | ONE_OR_MORE | `one or many\b` |  |  |
| INITIAL | ONE_OR_MORE | `1\+` |  |  |
| INITIAL | ZERO_OR_ONE | `\\|o` |  |  |
| INITIAL | ZERO_OR_ONE | `zero or one\b` |  |  |
| INITIAL | ZERO_OR_MORE | `zero or more\b` |  |  |
| INITIAL | ZERO_OR_MORE | `zero or many\b` |  |  |
| INITIAL | ZERO_OR_MORE | `0\+` |  |  |
| INITIAL | ZERO_OR_MORE | `\}o` |  |  |
| INITIAL | ZERO_OR_MORE | `many\(0\)` |  |  |
| INITIAL | ONE_OR_MORE | `many\(1\)` |  |  |
| INITIAL | ZERO_OR_MORE | `many\b` |  |  |
| INITIAL | ONE_OR_MORE | `\}\\|` |  |  |
| INITIAL | ONLY_ONE | `one\b` |  |  |
| INITIAL | ONLY_ONE | `only one\b` |  |  |
| INITIAL | DECIMAL_NUM | `[0-9]+\.[0-9]+` |  |  |
| INITIAL | ONLY_ONE | `1\b(?=\s+[A-Za-z_"'])` |  | `1` is a cardinality before a name, a number or a line, else an entity name. |
| INITIAL | ONLY_ONE | `1\b(?=\s+[0-9])` |  |  |
| INITIAL | ONLY_ONE | `1\b(?=--\|\.\.\|\.-\|-\.)` |  |  |
| INITIAL | ENTITY_ONE | `1\b` |  |  |
| INITIAL | NUM | `[0-9]+` |  |  |
| INITIAL | ONLY_ONE | `\\|\\|` |  |  |
| INITIAL | ZERO_OR_ONE | `o\\|` |  |  |
| INITIAL | ZERO_OR_MORE | `o\{` |  |  |
| INITIAL | ONE_OR_MORE | `\\|\{` |  |  |
| INITIAL | MD_PARENT | `u(?=[.\-\|])` |  | `u`: the parent end of a parent–child relationship. |
| INITIAL | NON_IDENTIFYING | `\.\.` |  | Lines: `--` or `to` (identifying, solid), `..`, `.-`, `-.` or `optionally to` (dashed). |
| INITIAL | IDENTIFYING | `--` |  |  |
| INITIAL | IDENTIFYING | `to\b` |  |  |
| INITIAL | NON_IDENTIFYING | `optionally to\b` |  |  |
| INITIAL | NON_IDENTIFYING | `\.-` |  |  |
| INITIAL | NON_IDENTIFYING | `-\.` |  |  |
| style | STYLE_TEXT | `(?:[^\x00-\x7F]\|\w\|-\|\*)+` |  |  |
| style | SEMI | `;` |  |  |
| INITIAL | UNICODE_TEXT | `(?:[^\x00-\x7F]\|\w\|-\|\*\|\.)+` |  | Names: letters, digits, `_`, `-`, `*`, `.` and anything outside ASCII. |
| INITIAL | CHAR | `.` |  |  |
| INITIAL | EOF | `$` |  | The end of the text. |

Removed before lexing (highlighted only):

- COMMENT: `^[^\S\n]*%%(?!\{)[^\n]+`
- DIRECTIVE: `[^\S\n]*%%\{[\s\S]*?\}%%`
